Welcome to Directorate of I.T

Muhammad Rehan Swati
Director IT

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

The Directorate of Information Technology at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is committed to advancing the university’s technological landscape and supporting its academic and administrative functions through innovative IT solutions. Our primary objective is to create a seamless digital environment that enhances teaching, learning, research, and administrative processes. We aim to provide robust, secure, and reliable IT services that empower the university community, ensuring they have the tools and resources necessary to excel in the digital age. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, we strive to elevate the university’s IT infrastructure to international standards, thereby contributing significantly to the institution’s overall growth and success. Unfortunately, with the passage of time and onslaught by the bellicose tribes, the human achievements spanning thousands of years were got buried under the debris of time. The establishment of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is a bold step forward to resurrect and bring back the same dazzling culture by mobilizing the intellectual resources of young scholars and to deepen their vision about the crying need to join together the human society irrespective of caste, colour or creed

Message

Welcome to the Directorate of Information Technology at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan!
In today’s rapidly evolving world, technology plays a pivotal role in shaping educational experiences and driving administrative efficiency. Our dedicated team at the Directorate of Information Technology is here to ensure that Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan remains at the forefront of digital innovation.
We are more than just an administrative section; we are the architects of the university’s digital transformation. Our mission is to provide cutting-edge IT services, support academic endeavors, and streamline administrative processes. Through the seamless integration of technology, we aim to enhance the learning environment, facilitate groundbreaking research, and optimize administrative functions.
As a vital administrative section, we are committed to providing unwavering support to students, faculty, and staff. Whether you need assistance with online learning platforms, research tools, data management, or any other IT-related matter, our team is here to help. We continually invest in the latest technologies and best practices to ensure that our university community has access to the most reliable and secure IT infrastructure.
Our goal is to empower every member of the university community with the tools they need to succeed. We believe that by embracing technology, we can unlock new possibilities, foster innovation, and create a vibrant academic environment. Together, let’s embark on a digital journey that transforms challenges into opportunities and paves the way for a brighter, technologically enriched future.
Welcome to a world where technology meets education, and possibilities are limitless.
Welcome to the Directorate of Information Technology at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan – your gateway to a digital future!

Services Provided By Directorate of I.T:

Network Infrastructure: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Ensuring a robust and reliable network infrastructure, we provide 600 MB high-speed internet access across the campuses, facilitating seamless communication and data exchange.

University Management System "UMS": (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

The University Management System serves as the technological backbone of our academic institution, revolutionizing the way we manage our administrative and academic processes. This integrated platform seamlessly amalgamates various functionalities, including student enrollment, course scheduling, grade management, and faculty coordination, into one cohesive system. It ensures efficient communication between departments, simplifies complex administrative tasks, and provides real-time insights into the university’s operations. Through user-friendly interfaces, stakeholders, including students, faculty, and administrative staff, can access pertinent information, track academic progress, and manage resources effectively. Moreover, the system facilitates data-driven decision-making, enabling the university to optimize its resources, enhance student experiences, and maintain the highest academic standards. With the University Management System in place, we are empowered to focus on delivering exceptional education and fostering a vibrant learning community, knowing that our administrative processes are streamlined, secure, and well-organized.

Secure Data Management: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Implementing state-of-the-art data security measures, we ensure safe storage, backup, and management of sensitive university data, fostering a secure digital environment.

Official Website: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

We specialize in the development and maintenance of the university’s official website, creating user-friendly, responsive, and visually appealing platforms that showcase the institution’s achievements, programs, and events. Our websites are designed to enhance the university’s online presence, ensuring seamless interaction with students, faculty, and the wider community.

Security and Surveillance Systems: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Implementing cutting-edge security solutions, we deploy advanced security cameras and surveillance systems across the campus, enhancing safety and security. Our strategically placed cameras provide real-time monitoring, deterring potential security threats and ensuring the well-being of students, faculty, and staff.

AI Attendance System: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI), we have implemented an innovative attendance system that accurately tracks and manages staff attendance. This system enhances efficiency, reduces manual workload, and ensures precise attendance records. Our AI-based solution promotes transparency and streamlines administrative processes, contributing to the overall efficiency of the university.

IT Consultations: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Our experienced IT professionals offer expert consultations, guiding the university community on technological advancements, software selection, and IT best practices.

Technical Support: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Providing prompt and efficient technical support, our team assists with IT-related issues, ensuring uninterrupted access to essential digital resources for students, faculty, and staff.

Cybersecurity Solutions: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Implementing comprehensive cybersecurity solutions, we protect the university’s digital assets, networks, and systems from cyber threats, ensuring data integrity and user privacy.

Hardware and Software Procurement: (https://awkum.edu.pk/administration/directorate-of-i-t/)

Assisting in hardware and software procurement, we ensure the acquisition of reliable and compatible IT resources for various university departments and initiatives.
